features.feature: Find / Replace / Find Next / Use Selection for Find

Replace: Tab in the bar moves to a replace field, Return (or Edit > Replace) replaces the selected match and steps on, Edit > Replace All replaces in every note; one undo step each. Built on parity/team-d-stickies; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Verify Replace and Replace All on Midget; Find still uses the in-app bar rather than the SDK find bar.
